svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: A home with three projects
svg.desc: An isometric scene. A home repository holds the list of projects and the rules they share. Lanes carry the shared rules to three projects. Each project keeps its own rules and its own gate.
svg.text: one private repository keeps the list and the shared rules
